headline: Critical Signs Hidden Water Damage Demands Professional Bathroom Help
articleBody:
Taking out an old tub to install a walk-in shower is an exciting upgrade, but certain issues behind the walls require an experienced hand. If you spot any of the following warning signs, it is time to call in a professional:

- Spongy or soft subflooring around the tub edge, pointing to long-term subfloor moisture damage.
- Persistent mildew or mold odors behind tile panels that do not clear up with standard cleaning.
- The drain line needs to be expanded or relocated to meet modern shower drainage requirements.
- Wall framing studs show dark staining, decay, or rot once the old enclosure is removed.
- You need accessibility upgrades like reinforced backing for grab bars and zero-threshold entry.
- Plumbing valves or supply pipes are corroded, outdated, or leaking behind the wall cavity.

When Professional Guidance Helps:
Plumbing connections, proper drain slope, and continuous waterproofing systems must be done right to prevent future structural issues.
